decisionEvents.ret: "You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before, as it were?"
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"Can we talk?" Lena sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"About what you did with your hands — You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before? Anyway, that's me."
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."

"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"

I've talked down three fights this month. It's a skill. A tiring one.
Arguments cost calories. I do the math out loud until people stop.
Somebody has to be the calm one. I've taken the job.
You two sort it out, or I will, and nobody likes my version.

sayLines.line: 🧳 A traveler swears Emberhold, south, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. Emberhold is starving.)
Word will travel: Haven is clean hands. (Opinion +2 with every village that knows you.)
🌧️ The storm rolls over Haven like a held breath let go — rain hammering the tarps, the wind testing every knot Jorge tied. Inside, it's almost cozy. Almost.

💛 You hold Coat button. The last winter before the scattering. You don't talk about it. The button remembers the weight of that coat, the cold that got in anyway, and who was wearing it. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📺 One gate. One beast. The crowd is a held breath.
